facts.material: tin-silver-copper alloy (SAC type, tin predominant, silver assumed about 3-4%)
facts.function: solder powder to make solder paste

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 7106 covers silver in powder form; chapter 71 note 5(c) treats an alloy with 2 percent or more silver as an alloy of silver and note 6 extends that to the whole tariff schedule

rejected_alternatives.reason: tin powders and flakes; applies if silver is under 2 percent (as for the tin-lead powder in N357709), otherwise silver alloy note 5(c) governs
unwrought tin alloys; goods are powder, not unwrought blocks/ingots
copper-tin bronze is not the composition (tin predominates)

missing_facts: percentage by weight of silver (2 percent or more makes it a silver alloy under ch 71 note 5)
classification.rationale: Powder of tin, silver and copper. Chapter 71 note 5(c) and 6 treat an alloy with at least 2 percent silver as silver, so heading 7106 powder applies (SAC grades carry about 3 percent silver). N357709 (tin-lead solder powder, 8007.00.3200) is the fallback if silver is below 2 percent; it does not settle this good.
